description: Browse up to 32 Project Gutenberg books by downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot. Filter by language, topic, MIME prefix, copyright status, media type or Library of Congress Classification. Media type and classification filters require the local mirror. Truncated results include executable search continuation.

copyright.description: Any selected source copyright status: "true" copyrighted, "false" public domain in the USA, "null" unknown. Empty means all statuses; this is not worldwide legal clearance.

languages.description: Restrict to books in these catalog language codes, exactly as results report them ("en", not "eng"). Example: ["en"] for English only, ["de", "fr"] for German or French, ["ang"] for Old English. Omit for all languages.

lcc.description: Any listed Library of Congress Classification prefix, ignoring case. Example: ["PS", "PR"]. Requires the local mirror.

limit.description: Requested number of books. Default 20; requests above 32 are capped locally at 32.

media_type.description: Any listed catalog media type, matched exactly ignoring case. Examples: ["Text"], ["Sound"]. Requires the local mirror.

mime_type.description: Literal prefix of a format MIME key, such as "text/plain" or "application/pdf". Type and subtype casing is normalized; parameter suffixes retain literal case. Blank means unset.

topic.description: Filter by a subject or bookshelf keyword (case-insensitive phrase match). Example: "science fiction", "adventure", "detective". Applies on top of the language filter.

name: gutenberg_browse_popular

appliedLimit.description: Book limit applied locally, at most 32.

books.description: Top books by downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot, most popular first.

birth_year.description: Birth year, or null if unknown.

death_year.description: Death year, or null if unknown or still living.

download_count.description: Downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot — the popularity ranking basis.

has_plain_text.description: True for Text records with UTF-8 plain text; HTML-only editions can still have is_readable=true.

is_readable.description: Eligible Text record with UTF-8 plain text, or HTML without audio formats. Does not guarantee the mirror file exists.

lcc.description: Library of Congress Classification codes. [] means none in the RDF; null means unavailable.

media_type.description: Catalog media type, such as "Text" or "Sound".

catalogAsOf.description: Last recorded bulk RDF archive checkpoint, or null when unavailable or inapplicable.

continuation.description: Present only when more matching books exist.

arguments.description: Executable search arguments preserving all filters. Page 1 may repeat already shown books when the browse cap cuts a page.

author.description: Every word must match one creator’s name or aliases, ignoring case and accents. Requires the local mirror.

author_year_end.description: An author has a known birth or death year on or before this year (CE positive, BCE negative). With author_year_start, one author must meet both bounds.

author_year_start.description: An author has a known birth or death year on or after this year (CE positive, BCE negative). With author_year_end, one author must meet both bounds.

contents.description: Literal phrase in the catalog table of contents, ignoring case, accents and whitespace runs. Requires the local mirror.

contributor.description: Every word must match a contributor name, ignoring case and accents. Requires the local mirror.

copyright.description: Any selected source copyright status: "true" copyrighted, "false" public domain in the USA, "null" unknown. Empty means all statuses; this is not worldwide legal clearance.

ids.description: Restrict to these Gutenberg IDs, intersected with other filters. An empty list selects nothing; omit for unrestricted IDs.

languages.description: Any listed two- or three-letter catalog language code; empty means all languages.

lcc.description: Any listed Library of Congress Classification prefix, ignoring case. Example: ["PS", "PR"]. Requires the local mirror.

media_type.description: Any listed catalog media type, matched exactly ignoring case. Examples: ["Text"], ["Sound"]. Requires the local mirror.

mime_type.description: Literal prefix of a format MIME key, such as "text/plain" or "application/pdf". Type and subtype casing is normalized; parameter suffixes retain literal case. Blank means unset.

page.description: One-indexed page of at most 32 matches. Pages beyond the result range are errors.

query.description: Every nonblank word must occur in the title or an author name as a literal substring. The local mirror also searches alternative titles and ignores case and accents. Live matching is upstream-defined. More than four words require the local mirror.

sort.description: Popular orders by source-snapshot downloads in the last 30 days, with ID tie-breaks locally; ascending and descending order by Gutenberg ID.

topic.description: Phrase in a subject or bookshelf, ignoring case and, on the local mirror, accents; blank means unset.

translator.description: Every nonblank word must occur in a translator name as a literal substring, ignoring case and accents. Requires the local mirror. Whitespace separates words.

tool.description: Tool to call for the remaining matching books.

effectiveCriteria.description: Normalized browse criteria, including popular sort and first page.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `filter_requires_mirror`: A media type or LCC filter was supplied while the local mirror could not answer. `catalog_unavailable`: The Project Gutenberg catalog did not answer, or returned an unreadable page, within the time this server allows for one browse. `catalog_rejected`: The live Project Gutenberg catalog refused the browse outright rather than failing temporarily. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance for empty or capped results.

requestedLimit.description: Positive integral book limit requested before capping.

shown.description: Number of books returned in this response.

totalInCatalog.description: Total books matching the filter in the full catalog (useful for context — "top 20 of 60,000").

truncated.description: True when the catalog held more matches than were returned.

truncationCeiling.description: Downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot for the least-popular book shown; omitted books have at most this count.
